title: 2.8.1.1  Objectif 8. Autosens is ON but it is not
symptom: After starting objective 8, the Autosens setting is ON but the OpenAPS SMB page shows Autosens as not activated. Toggling the setting off and on activates it.
cause: The OpenAPS SMB tab was still showing data from the last loop run before activating the objective; it resolves with the next loop.
fix: Wait for the next loop run; the issue resolves automatically. No code change needed.
evidence_quote: Then it is highly likely that the OpenAPS SMB tab was still showing the data from the last loop run before activating the objective. I tried to reproduce it and with the next loop it resolves as expected.
